ei.title: The Unseen Harm of Digital Business
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: As businesses shift some core business activities to digital, such as sales, marketing, or archiving, it is assumed that the impact on the environment will be less negative. However, digital business activities can still threaten the environment. In some cases, the harm of digital businesses can be even more hazardous. A few decades ago, offices used to have much more paper waste since all documents were paper based. When workplaces shifted from paper to digital documents, invoices, and emails, it was a promising step to save trees. However, the cost of the Internet and electricity for the environment is neglected. A recent Wired report declared that most data centers' energy source is fossil fuels. When we store bigger data on clouds, increased carbon emissions make our green clouds gray. The carbon footprint of an email is smaller than mail sent via a post office, but still, it causes four grams of CO₂, and it can be as much as 50 grams if the attachment is big.

questions.passage: As businesses (A)[shift / keep] some core business activities to digital, such as sales, marketing, or archiving, it is assumed that the impact on the environment will be less negative. However, digital business activities can still (B)[protect / threaten] the environment. In some cases, the harm of digital businesses can be even more hazardous. A few decades ago, offices used to have much more paper waste since all documents were paper based. When workplaces shifted from paper to digital documents, invoices, and emails, it was a promising step to save trees. However, the cost of the Internet and electricity for the environment is (C)[neglected / noticed]. A recent Wired report declared that most data centers' energy source is fossil fuels. When we store bigger data on clouds, increased carbon emissions make our green clouds gray. The carbon footprint of an email is smaller than mail sent via a post office, but still, it causes four grams of CO₂, and it can be as much as 50 grams if the attachment is big.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) shift=옮기다/전환하다, (B) threaten=위협하다, (C) neglected=간과된
det.analysis:
✅ ① shift — threaten — neglected: 원문 일치. 핵심 활동을 디지털로 전환하고(shift), 환경을 위협하며(threaten), 비용이 간과된다(neglected)는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② keep: '유지하다'는 디지털로 전환한다는 맥락과 반대
❌ ③ protect: '보호하다'는 환경을 위협한다는 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ noticed: '주목받는'은 간과된다는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: businesses shift ~ to digital / can still threaten the environment / is neglected

det.analysis:

det.korean: source: (A) 정보의 출처 / (B) 에너지의 원천(공급원)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 원천: (A)는 정보의 '출처'를 뜻함
✅ ② (A) 출처 — (B) (에너지) 원천/공급원: (A)는 'the source of the information(정보의 출처)'에서 출처, (B)는 'energy source is fossil fuels(에너지원)'에서 원천/공급원이라는 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 강의 발원지: (A)는 정보의 '출처'이지 강의 발원지가 아님
❌ ④ (B) 강의 발원지: (B)는 에너지의 '원천'이지 강의 발원지가 아님
det.tip: source: ① (명사) 출처 ② (명사) 원천/공급원 ③ (명사) 강의 발원지

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "gases that are sent out into the air, especially ones that harm the environment"

det.korean: emissions=배출(물): 공기 중으로 방출되는, 특히 환경에 해로운 기체
det.analysis:
❌ ① invoices: '청구서'는 기체가 아님
❌ ② documents: '문서'는 기체가 아님
❌ ③ trees: '나무'는 배출되는 기체가 아님
✅ ④ emissions: '배출(물)'은 공기 중으로 방출되는 해로운 기체로 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: emissions = 배출(물). gases sent out into the air가 핵심

questions.passage: A few decades ago, offices used to have much more paper waste since all documents were paper __________ (base). When workplaces shifted from paper to digital documents, invoices, and emails, it was a promising step to save trees.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 과거분사의 형용사적 용법: paper-based (종이에 기반을 둔)
det.analysis: 'all documents were paper __________ (base)'에서 문서가 종이에 '기반을 둔' 상태를 나타내므로 과거분사가 필요하다. be + 과거분사로 상태를 표현. base → based (paper based = 종이 기반의).
det.tip: paper based = 종이 기반의. be based = 기반을 두다

questions.passage: When workplaces __________ (shift) from paper to digital documents, invoices, and emails, it was a promising step to save trees. However, the cost of the Internet and electricity for the environment is neglected.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 과거 시제: 과거에 일어난 전환이므로 과거형 shifted
det.analysis: 'When workplaces __________ (shift) from paper to digital'에서 과거(it was a promising step)의 사건을 서술하므로 동사도 과거형이어야 한다. shift의 과거형은 shifted. shift → shifted.
det.tip: shift(현재) → shifted(과거). shift from A to B = A에서 B로 전환하다

questions.passage: As businesses shift some core business activities to digital, such as sales, marketing, or archiving, it is assumed that the impact on the environment will be __________. However, digital business activities can still threaten the environment. In some cases, the harm of digital businesses can be even more hazardous. A few decades ago, offices used to have much more paper waste since all documents were paper based. When workplaces shifted from paper to digital documents, invoices, and emails, it was a promising step to save trees. However, the cost of the Internet and electricity for the environment is neglected. A recent Wired report declared that most data centers' energy source is fossil fuels. When we store bigger data on clouds, increased carbon emissions make our green clouds gray. The carbon footprint of an email is smaller than mail sent via a post office, but still, it causes four grams of CO₂, and it can be as much as 50 grams if the attachment is big.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: less negative=덜 부정적인 — 디지털 전환으로 환경에 미치는 영향이 '덜 부정적일' 것이라 가정한다
det.analysis:
✅ ① less negative: 원문 일치. 핵심 활동을 디지털로 옮기면 환경에 미치는 영향이 덜 부정적일 것이라고 가정된다 ←정답
❌ ② far more harmful(훨씬 더 해로운): 가정 내용과 반대
❌ ③ completely gone forever(영원히 사라진): 본문 근거 없음
❌ ④ impossible to measure(측정 불가능한): 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: it is assumed that the impact on the environment will be less negative

questions.passage: As businesses shift some core business activities to digital, such as sales, marketing, or archiving, it is assumed that the impact on the environment will be less negative. However, digital business activities can still threaten the environment. In some cases, the harm of digital businesses can be even more hazardous. A few decades ago, offices used to have much more paper waste since all documents were paper based. When workplaces shifted from paper to digital documents, invoices, and emails, it was a promising step to save trees. However, the cost of the Internet and electricity for the environment is neglected. A recent Wired report declared that most data centers' energy source is fossil fuels. When we store bigger data on clouds, increased carbon emissions __________. The carbon footprint of an email is smaller than mail sent via a post office, but still, it causes four grams of CO₂, and it can be as much as 50 grams if the attachment is big.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: make our green clouds gray=우리의 녹색 클라우드를 회색으로 만든다 — 늘어난 탄소 배출의 결과
det.analysis:
❌ ① remove all the carbon from the air(공기 중 탄소를 모두 제거한다): 탄소 배출 증가와 반대
❌ ② save a large number of trees(많은 나무를 아낀다): 탄소 배출 증가 맥락과 다름
✅ ③ make our green clouds gray: 원문 'increased carbon emissions make our green clouds gray'와 일치. 친환경적으로 보이는 클라우드가 실제로는 탄소를 배출함 ←정답
❌ ④ reduce the cost of electricity(전기 비용을 줄인다): 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: increased carbon emissions make our green clouds gray
